import { Browser } from '/home/kaynooo/.cache/llm-bench/full-opus-1.27/nuxt-4/site/node_modules/happy-dom/lib/index.js'
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4701'
const browser = new Browser({ settings: { disableJavaScriptEvaluation: false, disableJavaScriptFileLoading: false, errorCapture: 'processLevel' } })
const page = browser.newPage()
page.virtualConsolePrinter.addEventListener('print', () => {})
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))
const doc = () => page.mainFrame.document
const until = async (fn, label) => { for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { try { if (fn()) return true } catch {} await sleep(100) } console.log('TIMEOUT', label); return false }

await page.goto(base + '/books')
await until(() => doc().querySelector('#__nuxt')?.__vue_app__, 'hydrate books')
const items = () => [...doc().querySelectorAll('ul[aria-label="Books"] li')].map(li => li.textContent.trim())
console.log('books', items().length)
const btn = label => [...doc().querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === label)
btn('gothic').click(); await sleep(200)
console.log('gothic', items(), btn('gothic').getAttribute('aria-pressed'), btn('All').getAttribute('aria-pressed'))
btn('All').click(); await sleep(200)
console.log('all', items().length)

await page.goto(base + '/books/dracula')
await until(() => btn('Add to favorites') && !btn('Add to favorites').disabled, 'fav button')
btn('Add to favorites').click(); await sleep(200)
console.log('after click', !!btn('Remove from favorites'), page.mainFrame.window.localStorage.getItem('bookshelf:favorites'))
await page.goto(base + '/books/dracula')
await until(() => btn('Remove from favorites') && !btn('Remove from favorites').disabled, 'fav persisted')

// client-side nav to /books via nav link
doc().querySelector('nav a[href="/books"]').click()
await until(() => doc().querySelector('h1')?.textContent === 'All books', 'nav books')
console.log('fav marks', items().filter(t => t.includes('Favorite')), doc().title, doc().querySelector('nav [aria-current]')?.textContent)

await page.goto(base + '/contact')
await until(() => doc().querySelector('#__nuxt')?.__vue_app__, 'hydrate contact')
const set = (sel, v) => { const el = doc().querySelector(sel); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new page.mainFrame.window.Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }
set('#contact-email', 'nope')
btn('Send').click(); await sleep(300)
console.log('errors', [...doc().querySelectorAll('.error')].map(e => e.textContent), doc().location.href)
set('#contact-name', '  Ada  '); set('#contact-email', 'ada@example.com'); set('#contact-message', 'A long enough message here.')
btn('Send').click()
await until(() => doc().querySelector('.success'), 'success')
console.log('success', doc().querySelector('.success')?.textContent, doc().querySelectorAll('.error').length)

await page.goto(base + '/books/nope')
await sleep(1000)
console.log('404', doc().title, doc().querySelector('h1')?.textContent)
doc().querySelector('main a[href="/books"]').click()
await until(() => doc().querySelector('h1')?.textContent === 'All books', 'back to books')
console.log('back', doc().title, items().length)
await browser.close()
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('/tmp/smoke/smoke.mjs').read()
i=s.index('settings: {')+len('settings: ')
# extract balanced braces
depth=0
for j in range(i,len(s)):
    if s[j]=='{': depth+=1
    elif s[j]=='}':
        depth-=1
        if depth==0: break
open('/tmp/smoke/settings.mjs','w').write('export default '+s[i:j+1]+'\n')
EOF
